mapper.select: SELECT d.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_doc_attachment` t WHERE t.`doc_type` = 'receive' AND t.`doc_id` = d.`id` AND t.`del_flag` = 0) AS attachmentCount FROM `t_doc_receive` d WHERE ORDER BY d.`create_time` DESC

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(d.`doc_no`, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM `t_doc_receive` d WHERE d.`doc_no` LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(d.`doc_no`) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 4
SELECT d.`status` AS status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM `t_doc_receive` d WHERE d.`del_flag` = 0 GROUP BY d.`status`
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_doc_receive` d WHERE d.`del_flag` = 0 AND d.`current_handler` = #{username} AND d.`status` NOT IN ('已办结', '已归档')
